name: Possible ransomware C2 beaconing
summary: Repeated HTTP check-ins from a workstation to an external web endpoint.
filter: ip && tcp && http.request.method == "GET" && http.request.uri contains "/gate.php" && http.user_agent contains "MSIE"
review: Check whether personal information became unavailable or left the environment.
playbook: Confirm the destination and timing against the workstation’s normal traffic.
Correlate the connection with endpoint process and DNS logs.
If compromise is confirmed, isolate the workstation and review the egress block with the network owner.

name: SQL injection indicators
summary: HTTP requests carrying SQL-related markers at an application boundary.
filter: ip && tcp && http.request && (upper(http.request.uri) contains "SELECT" || upper(http.request.uri) contains "UNION" || http.request.uri contains "1=1")
review: Review application and database records to establish whether personal information was accessed.
playbook: Review matching request metadata and application response logs.
Correlate requests with database audit events to assess any data access.
Review input handling with the application owner and verify parameterised queries.

name: Repeated SSH connection attempts
summary: A single source opens repeated connections to an SSH service within one minute.
review: Check authentication outcomes and whether any affected account could access personal information.
playbook: Check SSH authentication logs for failed or successful sign-ins.
Identify expected scans and approved administration sources.
Review account access and rate limits with the service owner.
